items.title: Season 2 "Nightfall" is live
items.summary: Night Marsh zone, the Sentinel Runner shell, The Cradle stat-customization system, Frost Mine and Vector Grenade, faster faction progression, and a recovery cap reduction (100% → 70%).

items.title: Launch, Learnings, and What’s Next
items.summary: Marathon’s game director reflects on the journey so far and the weird and wild path ahead.

items.title: Ranked mode enters beta
items.summary: Six ranks (Bronze through Pinnacle) with three divisions each; Platinum+ unlocks more dangerous zones. Loadouts must meet a minimum credit value, and a Holotag sets score targets.

items.title: Cryo Archive endgame zone unlocked
items.summary: The community ARG concluded, opening the hub-and-spoke endgame zone. Bungie had asked reviewers to hold final verdicts until this content launched.

items.title: Marathon launches on PS5, Windows, and Xbox Series X|S
items.summary: Bungie's extraction shooter releases with full cross-play and cross-save, six factions, solos and trios, and a cosmetics-only monetization model (Silk / Lux).
